```{=html}
<div class="fbc">

  <p class="fbc-title">Feedback Checker</p>
  <p class="fbc-sub">Type a sentence of feedback and see how agentic or communal it sounds.</p>

  <label class="fbc-label" for="fbc-input">Your feedback</label>
  <textarea id="fbc-input" class="fbc-input" rows="3" disabled>She should be more confident when presenting to clients.</textarea>
  <button class="fbc-button" type="button" disabled>Analyse</button>
</div>

<style>
  .fbc { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #31333F; }
  .fbc * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .fbc-title { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0; }
  .fbc-sub { color: #6c757d; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .fbc-label { display: block; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
  .fbc-input {
    width: 100%; padding: 0.6rem; border: 1px solid #D6D6D9; border-radius: 6px;
    background: #F0F2F6; color: #31333F; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem; resize: none;
  }
  .fbc-button {
    margin-top: 0.6rem; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9A36B2; border-radius: 6px;
    background: white; color: #9A36B2; font-weight: 600; cursor: not-allowed;
  }
</style>
```
